prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Production 16-bit pixel-art modular game boss component sheet, true transparent background. Reference is the Toxic Portal Warden from Bullets of Fury: preserve its exact industrial olive/black armored identity, huge circular green reactor, two tall green toxic cylinders, heavy ED-209-like machinery. Rebuild into SEPARATE detached modular components, not whole assembled robots. A strict 4 columns by 2 rows equal-cell sheet, 1536x1024 total, 384x512 cells; generous empty transparent gutters. Cell 0: central torso ONLY with giant round green reactor and small front mask, NO legs, NO guns, NO side canisters. Cell1: long articulated LEFT front armored claw leg, upper joint at top center, claw toward bottom left. Cell2: RIGHT front leg mirror. Cell3: rear articulated left support leg, joint at top, foot at bottom. Cell4: rear right support leg mirror. Cell5: one detached six-barrel rotary chaingun turret pointing south/down, pivot at top center, barrels bottom. Cell6: one intact glowing green toxic vertical canister with steel caps, pipes. Cell7: detached heavy front face mask plate, dark metal, small green slit. Each component fully visible and isolated, matching scale/detail and reference colors; no duplicates, no text, no labels, no grid lines, no shadows/background, no assembled boss anywhere. These parts will be rigged and rotated programmatically. Crisp sprite pixels and black outline.

prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: upright standing toxic dimensional portal animation sprite sheet for a 16-bit arcade shooter. Strict 4 columns x 4 rows =16 equal square cells, 1536x1536, row major sequence. Actual transparent background outside each effect; black void INSIDE portal. NO ground disk, NO flat circle, NO violet/purple/blue. A tall vertical standing oval doorway viewed frontally at a slight top-down three-quarter angle, toxic green fire and black tendrils with gray/white highlights. First4frames a vertical green slit opens and grows. Middle8frames full-size oval black doorway swirling with writhing green flames, flowing energy. Last4frames collapse into narrowing slit and vanish into tiny fading green sparks. Ground contact at bottom of each cell, identical centered axis and baseline, margins, no text or labels or grid or scenery. Fine crunchy pixel clusters, authored sprite detail, ready to crop into16 frames. Consistent doorway silhouette tall enough for a giant spider robot.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production 16-bit pixel-art TOXIC GREEN EXPLOSION animation spritesheet. EXACT 4 columns x 4 rows,16 frames in row-major chronological order,1024x1024, each 256x256 cell.
